## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — no direct DD ownership; enables task-2 which owns dd-1.)

## Given / When / Then
Given a seeded ticket store with N known orphan anomalies of mixed sides; When enumerate_orphan_anomalies() is imported from ticket-bridge-fsck and invoked; Then it returns exactly N records each carrying non-empty class_label, side in {local-only, jira-only}, proposed_remediation — AND existing fsck CLI produces identical stdout/exit-code to pre-change baseline.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] enumerate_orphan_anomalies() is importable and returns structured records (class_label, side, proposed_remediation)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/scripts/test_ticket_bridge_fsck_enumerate.py::test_enumerate_returns_structured_records
- [ ] Existing ticket-bridge-fsck CLI output is backward-compatible (byte-identical to golden capture)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/scripts/test_ticket_bridge_fsck_enumerate.py::test_cli_backward_compatible

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-bridge-fsck.py (Edit — add importable function, no CLI behavior change)
- tests/unit/scripts/test_ticket_bridge_fsck_enumerate.py (Create)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
